$Comment: Hunt, collect, cook, eat - the food loop in one quest.
The hunt step is PREFIX so every boar variant counts while nothing else does. The eat step is a
CONTAINS match on the Food_ family, so any meal closes it; it carries its own TextKey because
'eat 1 Food_' is not a sentence anyone wants to read.
Hunting and gathering share Order 1 and the meal waits at Order 2, so a player who already has
meat in the bag is not blocked from eating first.
